title: OCO index place code B* (Lauds, 5Q1)
prompt: Only one row: Lent week 5 Sunday, Lauds. The plain B antiphon for 5Q1 is also indexed. 1 index row(s). Examples: #1950 'Lazarus amicus' 5Q1|L|B* p209. Legend OCO pp1210-1213 does not define this code. Rows with it are held: the mapper (oco/oco_sigla.py) gives no lit_part_sources target, so identity can load but the assignment waits. Answer = what the code means and where the chant goes (service.part, epoch, option_txt). Carry-out: add the rule to oco_sigla.py, re-run oco/load_oco_lps.py, record it in oco/specs/README.md 'User rulings'.

options.label: Year A (Lazarus gospel)
options.detail: B* = Benedictus antiphon used when the Year A gospel (Lazarus, Jn 11) is read → LAUDS.antB cycle_sun 1 (or option_txt 'Anno A / cum Evangelio de Lazaro').

options.label: ad libitum alternative
options.detail: B* = optional alternative → LAUDS.antB next option, option_txt from the page rubric.
